messages:
Ella (Customer): Hi team — we're getting a bunch of JSON parse errors from the API for account acct-9987 after the 03/10 deploy. Client expects 'json_mode' structured output but responses sometimes come back malformed or as plain text. A couple of examples attached inline. ticket INC-2026-1458.

Jamie (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste one raw response and the request_id(s)? Also which model + route you're hitting?

Ella (Customer): request_id=req_7f9c2a4e, route=/v1/generate/chat, model param: redwood-4o (customer had pinned, but we use smart-routing so may fall back). Region: us-west-2. Here's the response we got: ```{"answer": "Here is the result", "metadata": {"score": 0.92} some trailing text``` — parser throws 'Unexpected token s in JSON at position 45'

Jamie (Support): thanks. That looks like truncated/mixed output (JSON then plain text). @Tom can you check if any fallback variants were used for req_7f9c2a4e and if schema enforcement applied on fallback?

Tom (eng-runtime): Looking now — req_7f9c2a4e routed to a fallback variant redwood-3b-q4. Our smart-routing policy allows fallback to smaller quantized variants under cpu/gpu pressure. Quick summary: strict_schema_enforcement is applied at the request router for the primary model, but currently our fallback path bypasses the post-processing step that wraps/validates structured output. That explains why the fallback emitted a plain-text continuation after the JSON object.

Tom (eng-runtime): Repro steps I used: 1) replayed the request body with same session/kvcache header 2) forced capacity constraint on redwood-4o to trigger fallback 3) captured raw stream — the fallback variant outputs an extra prompt-followup line: "\nFor more details, see..." appended after the JSON. Sample raw stream we recorded: ```{"answer":"Ok","metadata":{"score":0.86}}\nFor more details, see model docs: https://...``` — that breaks strict JSON parsers.

Priya (SRE): Oof. That trailing freeform text is definitely not acceptable for json_mode. Can we mitigate quickly by disabling fallback for routes using json_mode, or changing the fallback pool to only variants that guarantee structured output?

Tom (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation options: - disable smart-routing fallback for routes with json_mode=true (we can push a flag to routing config per-customer) - pin customer model to redwood-4o until we patch enforcement on fallback path - enable an output-sanitizer step in edge that strips trailing non-JSON (risky) I'm pushing a canary change to block fallback on json_mode routes now.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by tom — canary change to routing: "disable_fallback_for_json_mode=true" scheduled for 2026-03-11T14:12:00Z. Change id: dply-4621.

Jamie (Support): Ella — I'm going to apply the pin and ask eng to roll the canary. Will update INC-2026-1458 and share timeline. Do you need us to roll back any calls / issue credits?

Ella (Customer): Please pin to redwood-4o and apply any credits — we've had several failing jobs and downstream pipelines aborted. Appreciate the quick turn.

Tom (eng-runtime): Can confirm canary applied to 10% of routing traffic for this tenant's region. Also opened ENG-RT-789: "Enforce structured-output on fallback path" — root cause is missing schema validator in fallback postproc. Patch plan: (A) add validator + strict close policy to streaming postproc (B) add integration test that asserts fallback variants don't emit trailing text when json_mode=true (C) add perf guard so validator cheap for small responses.

Priya (SRE): I'll monitor latency/err rates from the canary. If errors drop, we can roll to 100% and then coordinate a hotfix release for the validator. Please include correlation_id header for future traces (use X-Corr: corr_0a1b2c) so we can link logs.

Jamie (Support): Quick repro snippet for support engineers (API to pin model): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct-9987/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate/chat","model":"redwood-4o"}'``` — I'll run it now and report.

Jamie (Support): Applied pin for acct-9987, verified no fallbacks on sample replay. Marking customer as mitigated in INC-2026-1458. Will coordinate refund/credits with finance.

Tom (eng-runtime): Follow-ups for root cause: ensure fallback policy includes 'output_mode_compatibility' and add CI tests for structured output for every model variant that can be selected as fallback. I'll own ENG-RT-789.

Ella (Customer): Thank you all. Please keep me posted on the permanent fix and the credit handling.

Jamie (Support): Will do — next steps: Tom to deliver validator + tests (ENG-RT-789), Priya to monitor canary and rollback if regression, Support to confirm credits and close INC-2026-1458 after fix verification. :white_check_mark:

Tom (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll post a short postmortem when ENG-RT-789 is resolved and include recommended routing policy changes to prevent this class of schema drift.

deploy-bot: canary dply-4621 successfully rolled to 100% for acct-9987 at 2026-03-11T14:26:30Z.
